_comment: Every hook script is a single cross-platform hooks/*.py file. The 'python' interpreter token in each command is a template: tools/install-ba-assistant.py (and the upgrader) rewrite it to `py` (Windows) or `python3` (Mac/Linux) when merging into ~/.cursor/hooks.json. beforeMCPExecution runs the Jira DoR gate with failClosed:true, so a crash of the gate script blocks the call; the installer wraps that command on Mac/Linux so a MISSING interpreter allows the call instead of blocking every MCP tool (on Windows, if the py launcher is not found at install time, the gate is registered with failClosed:false and the installer warns). sessionStart runs session-init.py only (the old prompt-type re-entry hook was removed: prompt hooks are judged by a separate small model and do not drive the assistant; the re-entry card lives in execution-router.mdc). stop can emit followup_message but is off unless `stopFollowup: true` in ba-assistant-config.mdc. beforeSubmitPrompt additional_context is not read by Cursor today (registered for future-proofing only). postToolUse carries the shared-repo warning (afterFileEdit has no output channel).
